# Holiday Burnt Gifts Farming

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_49_nukaknights-post-gifts-farming.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

#### Current dates:

- 
### 12/17/2024 - 01/02/2025**: Holiday Burnt Event**

In contrast to the Grubenhauer Treasure Hunters, you can farm the Holiday Burnt Event very well.

You don't need bottle caps for wrapping paper.

The best way to do this is on a private server. Either your own or that of a friendly player you are on.

## Procedure:

Equip workshops and CAMPS with Santatrons and then collect gifts / farm events. Of course, this guide only works during the Holiday Burnt Event.

## Instructions:

1. 
Get the **free Santatron** from the Atom Shop (Christmas Only)
2. 
Build the Santatron in your CAMP. It is best to lock the container and the terminal with a **lock** (wait until the bot is not in the station, only then can you attach a lock)
3. 
Now you take the **first workshop**.
4. 
In the first workshop you build a **construct** on which the **Santatron** can stand. He doesn't have to be able to walk around. It's also best to have a recycling box so that you can use scrap directly, and a few gun turrets so that the bot doesn't break during the first attack. Additionally, use the welcome doormat to set your spawn point in the workshop directly at the Santatron.
(Alternatively via Angry Turtle: Build a few stairs with a high platform and the Santatron up there. The mobs can't go up there and you save the guns)
5. 
You then create a **blueprint** of this construct with the Santatron.
6. 
Now you can take any **other workshops** and set up your blueprint there.
7. 
That's enough to farm in peace. From now on you just go to the workshop defenses, **collect** gifts** from the workshops and your CAMP.
8. 
In between you can still do **events like “Against the Sound Barrier” and “Collision Course”**. (Against the Sound Barrier is a public event that cannot be triggered. Collision Course is an event that you can trigger once an hour by going to Morgantown Airport. You can find many holiday burnts at these events.

## CONCLUSION

With this method you can get all the rewards in one evening without having to invest a bottle cap on wrapping paper.

**Here is an overview of the new rewards** and drop chances from the gifts (Update 2023): Holiday Burnt Event Rewards & Tips

## Tip for resources on the side

Build all sorts of collectors for food, buffs and resources in every workshop. 

e.g.

- Coffee machine
- Cookie jar
- Butterfly Refuge
- Stack of wood
- Visitor tea collector
- cement mixer
- Tree collector for glue
- or more

You can then either put perishable food in the military refrigerator (now available for gold) or on a storage char.
